Dental care on site

Dental attention, without leaving home.

Our mobile team visits residential care centres for dental examinations and straightforward treatments. Each visit is planned with the centre, around what is appropriate for the resident and possible on site.

Discuss your centre ↗What a visit involves ↓
01

Dental examinations

Check oral health, identify concerns, and discuss what needs attention.

02

Straightforward treatment

Provide suitable simple care during a planned visit to the centre.

The care available on site depends on each resident's needs and the facilities at the centre. We discuss the details before visits begin.

The resident's visit

A familiar place. A clear plan.

Your team knows each resident's routine. We agree on the practical arrangements with you so the appointment can take place at the centre.

Before

Agree on the visit

We discuss the centre's needs, suitable timing, and the care that may be possible on site.

During

See the resident

The dental team carries out the agreed examination or suitable straightforward treatment.

After

Discuss what follows

When further care is needed, we discuss the next step with the centre.

When more is needed

Some care needs a different setting.

An on-site visit will not be suitable for every treatment. If an examination shows that a resident needs care beyond what can be provided at the centre, we discuss what should happen next.

We will be clear about the scope of a visit before it is arranged, so your team knows what to expect.

How we work with care centres ↗

Questions about care

Let's talk through what your centre needs.

The exact arrangements depend on your residents and facilities. Tell us about your centre and we can discuss what is suitable.

Email Global Smile Care ↗+32 3 216 03 08
Can every treatment happen at our centre?+

No. The care possible on site depends on each resident's needs and the facilities at the centre. We discuss this before visits begin.

How do we arrange visit days?+

We agree on days and timing with your centre based on its needs and practical arrangements.

What if a resident needs further care?+

We discuss the next step when care cannot be completed during an on-site visit.
